exchangeNotice: Exchange phase — the elder chooses Propose or Stand; if proposed, the dealer Accepts or Refuses. After accepting, choose cards to discard and draw replacements.

hint.accept: Your hand is also weak — accept the exchange
hint.refuse: Your hand is strong — refuse the exchange
hint.discard: Discard low, non-scoring cards and draw replacements
hint.lead_trump: Lead a trump to capture the trick
hint.lead_high: Lead a high card to win the trick
hint.follow_cut: Trump in to capture this trick
hint.follow_win: Play a card that wins this trick
hint.follow_dump: Cannot win — discard a card you don't need

tutorial.info: Deal, trump suit (and the trump card), the stock count, and each player's match / deal score are shown here. Écarté is a 2-player French trick game played with a 32-card deck. The first player to reach the target score (default 5) wins.
tutorial.trick: Cards played to the current trick appear here. During play it is strict must-follow (follow suit and win if able, otherwise trump). The rank order is K>Q>J>A>10>9>8>7.
tutorial.hand: This is your hand. During play, click a card and press Play. In the Exchange phase, select the cards you want to discard and press Exchange.
tutorial.actions: In the Exchange phase the elder (non-dealer) chooses Propose or Stand; if proposed, the dealer Accepts or Refuses. After accepting, each player discards any number of cards and draws replacements, repeating until the stock empties. Then 5 tricks are played: 3+ tricks scores 1 point, all 5 (Vole) scores 2. Press Next Deal between deals and games.
